judgmentMethod: Manual reading by the coding agent of the pinned Indonesian source and the three user-specified anchors. Explicit content reasons per query; not automatic word-overlap labels, not independent human/scholarly verification. Additional retrieved results remain unjudged. These ten queries also guided lexical tuning, so this is a development pilot, not a held-out benchmark. Precision is a judged-positive lower bound; no exhaustive Recall.

cases.query: Kalau makan menurut sunnah sebaiknya pakai tangan apa?
cases.reason: User anchor 5376: includes right hand instruction for eating, not merely the word tangan.

cases.query: Saya mau tahu hadits tentang makan dengan tangan kanan.
cases.reason: User anchor 5376 directly describes eating with the right hand.

cases.query: Kalau makan bareng, boleh ambil lauk yang jauh dari kita?
cases.reason: 5376 and 5377 direct eating from the food in front of the person. 5446 concerns paired dates and permission, only adjacent context, not the spatial question.

cases.query: Apakah ada anjuran membaca bismillah sebelum makan?
cases.reason: 5376 includes the instruction to mention the name of Allah before eating; source spelling retained.

cases.query: Bagaimana nasihat Rasulullah buat orang yang gampang emosi?
cases.reason: 6116 advises against anger; 6114 explicitly describes strength as self-control while angry. Narratives that merely mention someone becoming angry do not suffice.

cases.query: Saya ingin tahu hadits tentang menahan amarah.
cases.reason: 6114 explicitly concerns self-control while angry; 6116 is advice against anger. Both address the intent beyond shared words.

cases.query: Kenapa kita harus mendahulukan ibu daripada ayah?
cases.reason: User anchor 5971 explicitly orders the mother before the father; search returns the source rather than generating an explanation.

cases.query: Ada hadits tentang berbakti kepada orang tua?
cases.reason: 5970 explicitly commands good conduct toward parents; 5971 prioritizes mother then father; 5974 narrates prioritizing care of elderly parents; 5976 warns against disobedience. 6079 mentions parents in a migration story, and 6127 means an elderly person: neither answers filial conduct.
Pinned Indonesian record 1 explicitly connects actions and intention. No inference from collection title or a shared word alone.

cases.query: Apa nasihat Nabi tentang menjaga ucapan?
cases.reason: 6018, 6019, 6135 and 6136 explicitly advise good speech or silence. 7 has incidental speech in a long historical dialogue, not advice about guarding speech.
